title: CYBRIK receipt signature envelope v1
description: Transport shape for one control-plane signature over one execution receipt, offered as a candidate for the envelope ADR-0004 F8 deferred. The signature itself is an ordinary compact JWS with an INCLUDED payload (three non-empty base64url segments) whose payload is the JCS rendering of cybrik.receipt-signature-statement.v1. Detached payloads and RFC 7797 b64=false are rejected. Only EdDSA over Ed25519 is permitted; alg=none is rejected. The envelope carries NO key material: jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, x5t, x5t#S256 and epk are all forbidden in the protected header, and kid resolves only against the pinned external trust bundle named by trust_bundle_ref. signature_locator is the ledger address of the exact compact JWS bytes and is the value the receipt's own `signature` field carries. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). No ADR decision, no runtime, no signer, no issuer and no key lifecycle follow from this file.

envelope_version.description: Version of the envelope profile document.

digest_profile.description: Receipt digest profile the bound receipt_digest was produced under. Must agree with the signed statement inside jws_compact.

canonicalization.description: Canonical JSON rendering used for the receipt bytes, the protected header and the payload.

receipt_id.description: receipt_id of the signed receipt. Must equal the receipt_id inside the signed payload.

receipt_digest.description: Digest of the signed receipt under digest_profile. Must equal the receipt_digest inside the signed payload and the digest recomputed from the exact transmitted receipt.

signature_locator.description: Content-addressed ledger locator whose hex component is the SHA-256 of the exact compact JWS bytes. It is an address, never a fetch instruction to a verifier: a verifier that has the bytes recomputes the hex and compares. This exact string is what the receipt's `signature` field carries.

jws_compact.description: Ordinary compact JWS with an included payload: three non-empty unpadded base64url segments separated by dots. The protected header key set is exactly {alg, kid, typ}; the payload is the JCS rendering of the signed statement. Never detached, never b64=false.

alg.description: JOSE algorithm. Ed25519 EdDSA only; alg=none and every other value are rejected.

key_type.description: Key type declaration only. It names the curve; it never carries the key. The public key itself lives exclusively in the pinned external trust bundle.

kid.description: Signer key id, identical to the kid in the protected header and in the signed statement. Resolved only against the pinned external trust bundle.

trust_bundle_ref.description: Pinned reference to the external trust bundle a verifier resolves kid against. bundle_uri is a pinned identifier, not a fetch instruction; a verifier that cannot match bundle_digest against a bundle it already trusts fails closed.

bundle_digest.description: SHA-256 over the JCS rendering of the trust bundle document.

signer_role.description: Who signed. Fixed to the Tool Fabric control plane: receipts are control-plane observed and control-plane signed, and an executor never holds a receipt-signing key (ADR-0004 F6; ADR-0006 E5). Executor evidence is attested INTO a receipt by the control plane; it is never an executor signature over one.

signed_at.description: Must equal signed_at in the signed statement. Advisory ordering only; not a validity window.
